description: This file declares the interface class IDataReader for reading media data segments within the Rialto server component, referencing the IMediaPipeline interface.

classes.name: IDataReader
classes.description: An interface for reading media data segments, providing a virtual destructor and a pure virtual method readData() that returns a vector of media segments.

methods.name: ~IDataReader
methods.description: Virtual destructor for the IDataReader interface.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Pure virtual method to read media data segments, returning a vector of media segments.
